definitions.explanation: The collective term for all employees at an educational institution, including both teachers and administrative or support staff.

examples.japanese: {教職員|きょうしょくいん}{向|む}けの{研修|けんしゅう}がある。
examples.english: There is a training session for the teaching staff.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}の{教職員|きょうしょくいん}は{約|やく}{五十|ごじゅう}{名|めい}だ。
examples.english: This school has about fifty faculty and staff members.

examples.japanese: {教職員|きょうしょくいん}{全員|ぜんいん}が{生徒|せいと}の{安全|あんぜん}を{最優先|さいゆうせん}に{考|かんが}えている。
examples.english: All faculty and staff consider student safety their top priority.

notes:
USAGE:
{教職員|きょうしょくいん} combines {教員|きょういん} (teaching staff) and {職員|しょくいん} (administrative staff) into a single collective term. It is used in official and institutional contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {教員|きょういん} — teachers only
- {職員|しょくいん} — non-teaching staff only
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん} — both teachers and staff combined
- {教師|きょうし} — teacher (more general, less institutional)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん}{会議|かいぎ} (faculty meeting)
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん}{組合|くみあい} (teachers' union)
- {教職員|きょうしょくいん}{一同|いちどう} (all faculty and staff)
